title: Two Toddlers Cook in Hot Car While Dad Shops Inside GameStop (Police Bodycam)
description:
On June 13th, 2025. Officers with the Port St Lucie Police Department arrested a man after finding two toddlers alone in the backseat of a car without air conditioning.  A witness called 911 to report two children left unattended in a car without running the AC. The witness told police the children were crying, and their faces were flushed. The arrest report shows both were in distress.
